_readme: Deterministic transcription fixes applied to meeting summaries and transcripts at sync time.
Each entry replaces every 'from' variant with 'to'. Matching is case-insensitive and
word-boundary anchored; spaces inside a variant match any run of whitespace. Text inside
URLs, email addresses, code spans, [[wikilinks]] and markdown link targets is never touched.
requireContext  Apply only when the note also contains one of these strings. Use it for
variants that are legitimate words or other people elsewhere in the vault
(e.g. 'Christian' is Krishan in a FactorLab standup, but a school name in
except          Literal phrases that are never rewritten, even when the gate passes.
enabled         Set false to keep an entry documented but inactive.
Preview the effect on the existing vault with `bun name-normalizer.ts` (dry run),
Deliberately absent: a bare 'Chris' -> 'Kris' rule. Granola renders both Kris Smith and
Krishan Yadav as 'Chris', so the token is genuinely ambiguous and is left alone.

corrections.note: Gated: 'Christian' is a school/person name in personal meetings. The gate requires another InstantSys/FactorLab teammate in the same note.
'Parth' is the common short form but he spells it Parthh, so the vault uses the double-h everywhere.
